## Scope

Continues #1462 (does not close it). Restore exact Light airport content: rank15+
uses ref alone; lower ranks use ref plus English/local name when ref exists,
otherwise the name. Native requests all four columns; absent/empty values retain
the source semantics. Only the unique audited owner and untouched unsplit native
text expression are eligible. Class/worldview/zoom/font/priority/placement settings,
other label owners, Outdoors/custom styles and explicit overrides are preserved.

## Before / After

[Immutable gallery, full matrix, source and native audits, actual PDFs, replay workers](https://github.com/ebelo/qfit/blob/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/README.md).
Panels: **Mapbox explicit-Mercator reference | QGIS Before ce90038 | QGIS After547cc22**.
Fresh2026-09-15; baseline`ce90038949761aa64140a8c49dbb4555c48fe94e`,
captured candidate`547cc2245b8d73135fc9b0b8dea5d84e66e4b4d1`. Final head`f8fa1a61270c87a2a9ecee1df8db0aa8289bcb72` has identical233runtime
Python files; only assessment/harness documentation follows the captured code.
1280×900EPSG3857; QGIS3.44.11/Qt5.15.17 at100DPI,4.2.0/Qt6.9.2 at96DPI.
Source SHA256`87413e46c074e13aef420958a3ad101961766e6645336608e399ceccaffc6d32`.
Source globe retained separately; native/source zoom and live tile-byte parity are not claimed.

![Geneva low-zoom code: reference, QGIS3 Before, QGIS3 After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebelo/qfit/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/geneva-airport-z10-qgis3-crop.png)

Geneva z10: **GVA** replaces the local multi-line name, as the source requires.
Unscaled380×300 crop`(450,380,830,680)` per panel; [full map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebelo/qfit/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/geneva-airport-z10-qgis3-full.png).

![Cairo code and English name: reference, QGIS4 Before, QGIS4 After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebelo/qfit/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/cairo-airport-z14-qgis4-crop.png)

Cairo z14: **CAI — Cairo International Airport**, preserving the literal source
hyphen/newline. Native type remains too small/narrowly wrapped (C18 OPEN).
Crop`(620,230,1000,530)`; [full map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebelo/qfit/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/cairo-airport-z14-qgis4-full.png).

![Bern lower-rank content: reference, QGIS4 Before, QGIS4 After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebelo/qfit/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/bern-urban-z12-light-qgis4-crop.png)

Bern z12: rank14 now shows **BRN — Bern Airport**. Crop`(780,580,1160,880)`;
[full map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ebelo/qfit/3a773fe351caf585cbfd6c68bac5e63fe18983be/docs/visual-evidence/issue-1462/airport-content/bern-urban-z12-light-qgis4-full.png).
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors; reference cartography © Mapbox.

## Evidence and independent verdicts

- C19/C02:126native text cases,35class/worldview combinations and missing-rank
  check. All14owners/39rules audited: airport21mismatches→0; other85unchanged.
  Observed-property replay:6rendered-camera cases and8loaded-source cases per build,
  separately counted, allAftercontent/predicate disagreements0. Not unique-airport
  counts/native-decoder equivalence. Cairo no-ref Bilbeis/Al Mansurah name removals
  follow rank15+ source output, not changed eligibility.
- C14: **PARTIAL, airport text only**; transport infrastructure/rail/ferry not certified.
  C01/C29:88nativePNG,44native image/settings/context repeat pairs exact;44primary
  browserPNG+8loaded-source queryPNG, all repeats exact.110actual Mercator anchors
  align<1e-6px. Both public-worker replays match. Five standard Swiss maps unchanged;
  Zurich/Bern airport names change. Other label text/provider populations remain.
- Fidelity mixed: Cairoz14 MAE+0.361710%/+0.083258% (QGIS3/4), all other changed
  views improve. Remaining typography is explicit OPEN work, not noise/accepted limitation.
- Actual output:16PDFs from production150DPI forced-vector settings, two airports,
  both builds, Before/After repeats. Correct airport strings visually inspected.
  QGIS3 rasters repeat exactly; QGIS4 repeats differ880/1175pixels Cairo,
 182/109Geneva. **C29 OPEN**, C28density detail OPEN; no full-atlas/desktop pass.
  Docker fonts are not bundled by ZIPs. No activity/accessibility/RTL-shaping claim.

## Gates

- Final local:2681passed/192skipped/328subtests.
- Both complete `bash scripts/docker_test.sh 3` / `4`:217passed/82skipped each,
  no pytest argument override. LegacyQGIS3.34.4 airport:1passed/161subtests.
- Both plugin ZIP builds;9package tests; `git diff --check` pass.
- Required CI/security/Sonar, exact-head Codex and Greptile reviews pending;
  not merge-ready until clean. Every source/container capture preflight authorized
  HTTP200/TLS. Failed mount/image-ID attempts excluded, recovered without credential,
  TLS or host-permission changes.

Whole ledger now8OPEN/16PARTIAL/5NOTASSESSED/1source-backedN/A; no limitation accepted.
No release, deployment or issue closure. Remaining eight coalesce families,
zoom/role handoff, typography, topology/seams and operational scope continue.

Summary

 This PR restores the Mapbox Light airport label expression after generic style simplification while narrowly preserving existing label ownership, eligibility, and presentation settings. - Reconstructs rank-dependent airport code and English/local-name behavior using native QGIS expressions. - Applies the repair only to the audited Light airport owner before font-band generation. - Adds focused coverage for rank boundaries, missing/NULL/empty properties, ownership isolation, settings preservation, and idempotence. - Documents the scoped cartographic assessment and remaining fidelity limitations.
